about.title: Who Am I?
about.text: Hi, I'm a fullstack developer with a passion for frontend development. I've built a strong foundation in web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for creating responsive and engaging user interfaces. As a beginner, I have foundational knowledge in Java and PHP, which allows me to start building server-side applications and understand the basics of database management.
